name: classification
description: Are category, priority, product_area and needs_human each correct for this issue under the rubric? 5 = all four correct; 1 = category wrong or several fields wrong.

name: faithfulness
description: Does the summary state only what the issue says, as one line of at most 160 characters? Any invented number, version, name, service or claim, or a statement that contradicts the issue, scores 2 or lower.

name: consistency
description: Is the output well-formed (all five fields present, no extra fields, values from the allowed sets) and consistent with the rubric's rules that must hold? 5 = fully consistent; 1 = malformed or breaks a rule.
